rationale: The bid-ask spread of 203 bps is prohibitively wide, meaning the position starts roughly 1% in the hole before any adverse move occurs. While the stock gapped down 5.34% and is now trading near the top of today's range (82.1%), the extremely thin volume (126K shares vs. a 2.51x relative volume that still implies very low absolute liquidity) and the wide spread create unfavorable execution conditions that make risk/reward unattractive in either direction. The mechanical edge required to overcome the spread cost is not clearly present.
